title: Barcelona Gaudi Escape
description: Modernist architecture, vibrant nightlife, and Mediterranean beaches

days.title: Sagrada Familia & Eixample
attractions: Sagrada Familia [Gaudi's unfinished basilica with intricate facades and soaring interior]
Park Guell [Gaudi-designed park with colorful mosaics and city views]
Casa Batllo [Gaudi's modernist apartment building with wavy facade]
La Pedrera [Apartment building with undulating stone exterior and rooftop sculptures]
Passeig de Gracia [Elegant boulevard with shops, cafes, and modernist architecture]
tips: Book Sagrada Familia tickets online weeks in advance
Visit Park Guell early morning for fewer crowds and better photography

days.title: Gothic Quarter & Beaches
attractions: Gothic Quarter [Medieval streets with narrow alleys and historic buildings]
Barcelona Cathedral [Gothic cathedral with cloisters and rooftop gargoyles]
Las Ramblas [Famous tree-lined pedestrian promenade with street performers]
Picasso Museum [Extensive collection of Picasso works and sketches]
Barceloneta Beach [Sandy beach with beach bars and Mediterranean views]
tips: Gothic Quarter best explored on foot early morning
Las Ramblas has pickpockets; keep valuables secure

days.title: Montserrat Day Trip
attractions: Montserrat Monastery [Benedictine monastery nestled among dramatic rock formations]
Montserrat Rock Formations [Unique geological formations for hiking and photos]
Cable Car Rides [Scenic transportation between monastery and surrounding peaks]
Black Madonna [Religious icon housed in the basilica]
Hiking Trails [Mountain paths with panoramic valley views]
tips: Train from Barcelona to Montserrat takes 1 hour
Wear sturdy hiking boots for mountain trails

title: Rome's Ancient Wonders
description: Colosseum, Vatican, and timeless Roman monuments

days.title: Roman Monuments
attractions: Colosseum [Ancient amphitheater built 72-80 AD with gladiator history]
Roman Forum [Archaeological site with temples, arches, and government buildings]
Palatine Hill [Imperial palace ruins with panoramic city views]
Trevi Fountain [Baroque fountain where visitors toss coins for return to Rome]
Pantheon [Ancient temple with massive dome and oculus]
tips: Book Colosseum skip-the-line tickets online
Visit Colosseum early morning or at sunset for fewer crowds

days.title: Vatican & Art
attractions: Vatican Museums [Vast art collection including Sistine Chapel ceiling]
Sistine Chapel [Michelangelo's painted ceiling and Last Judgment]
St. Peter's Basilica [Largest church in Christendom with Renaissance architecture]
Castel Sant'Angelo [Circular fortress with Tiber views and art museum]
Vatican Gardens [Papal gardens with sculptures and green spaces]
tips: Vatican Museums requires 4-5 hours minimum for proper viewing
Climb St. Peter's dome for panoramic Rome views (steep stairs)

days.title: Neighborhoods & Food
attractions: Trastevere [Historic neighborhood with cobblestone streets and evening nightlife]
Spanish Steps [Famous staircase with designer shops at base]
Campo de Fiori [Morning market and historic square]
Jewish Ghetto [Historic district with kosher restaurants]
Local Food Tour [Traditional pasta, gelato, and Italian specialties]
tips: Trastevere best visited evening for authentic restaurant experience
Campo de Fiori morning market offers fresh produce and local food

title: Athens & Santorini Quick
description: Ancient ruins, white-washed villages, and Mediterranean sunsets

days.title: Athenian Antiquities
attractions: Acropolis [Ancient citadel with Parthenon and temple ruins perched on hill]
Parthenon [5th-century BC temple dedicated to Athena with iconic columns]
Panathenaic Stadium [Ancient Olympic stadium hosting first modern Olympics]
Acropolis Museum [World-class museum with ancient sculptures and artifacts]
Plaka District [Historic neighborhood with narrow streets, tavernas, and shops]
tips: Arrive Acropolis at opening time to beat crowds
Wear comfortable shoes for extensive hill walking

days.title: Ferry to Santorini
attractions: Fira Caldera [Stunning cliff-top village overlooking volcanic caldera]
Oia Village [Famous white-washed village with sunset views]
Santorini Beaches [Black sand beaches from volcanic history]
Akrotiri Archaeological Site [Preserved Minoan settlement from 1600 BC]
Wine Tasting [Local Assyrtiko wine from volcanic vineyards]
tips: Ferry Athens to Santorini takes 5-7 hours
Book accommodations in Oia well in advance for sunset views

days.title: Santorini Island Exploration
attractions: Akrotiri [Excavated Minoan city with multi-story buildings preserved by ash]
Red Beach [Unique reddish sand beach surrounded by cliffs]
Ammoudi Bay [Fishing village at base of cliffs with fresh seafood tavernas]
Caldera Cruise [Boat tour around volcanic islands and hot springs]
Traditional Windmills [Whitewashed windmills on cliffs for photos]
tips: Rent ATV or car for island exploration flexibility
Caldera cruises best in late afternoon before sunset

title: Lisbon Coastal Charm
description: Historic tiles, pastries, and coastal beauty

days.title: Lisbon Old Town
attractions: Belem Tower [UNESCO fortress at Tagus River mouth from Age of Discovery]
Jeronimos Monastery [Architectural masterpiece with Gothic and Renaissance elements]
Pasteis de Nata [Famous custard tart dessert from Belem Bakery]
Tejo River Walk [Scenic waterfront promenade with views]
Discoveries Monument [Modern monument celebrating Portuguese explorers]
tips: Get Lisbon Card for unlimited public transport and museum entries
Try Pasteis de Nata at Pasteis de Belem (not tourist trap)

days.title: Alfama & Castle
attractions: Saint George's Castle [Medieval fortress with panoramic city views from walls]
Alfama District [Maze-like medieval neighborhood with Fado music venues]
Fado Museum [Exhibits on traditional Portuguese music culture]
Tram 28 [Historic streetcar through narrow Alfama streets]
Miradouro (viewpoint) [Best city views from multiple hilltop locations]
tips: Explore Alfama on foot; main streets have food vendors
Attend Fado performance in evening for authentic music and atmosphere

days.title: Sintra & Cascais Day Trip
attractions: Pena Palace [Romantic 19th-century palace with colorful architecture perched on mountain]
Quinta da Regaleira [Mysterious estate with underground chambers and gardens]
Sintra Old Town [UNESCO site with winding streets and historical buildings]
Cascais Coastal Town [Beach resort with seafood restaurants and promenade]
Cabo da Roca [Westernmost point of continental Europe with cliff views]
tips: Day trip from Lisbon; train from Rossio Station (30 minutes to Sintra)
Pena Palace requires significant hill walking; wear comfortable shoes

title: Dubrovnik Old Town
description: Medieval walled city, Adriatic coast, and Game of Thrones filming locations

days.title: Dubrovnik City Walls
attractions: City Walls [1,940m of fortifications surrounding Old Town with panoramic coastal views]
Old Town [UNESCO site with limestone streets and baroque architecture]
Rector's Palace [Gothic-Renaissance building with museum and dark interior]
Cathedral [Baroque cathedral with religious artifacts and artwork]
Stradun [Main street connecting city gates through heart of Old Town]
tips: Walk entire city wall at sunrise for empty streets and perfect lighting
Old Town can be extremely crowded; visit early morning or late evening

days.title: Island Excursion
attractions: Lokrum Island [Nearby island with botanical garden and Game of Thrones sites]
Elaphiti Islands [Ferry-accessible islands with beaches and villages]
Boat Tour [Scenic boat rides around Dubrovnik's coastline and islands]
Beach Swimming [Local beaches with clear Adriatic water]
Sunset Views [Best experienced from fortification walls or boat]
tips: Ferries to islands run frequently; no advance booking usually needed
Bring swimsuit and sunscreen for island beach time

days.title: Game of Thrones & History
attractions: Game of Thrones Locations [Dubrovnik Old Town served as King's Landing in TV series]
Pile Gate [Famous gate used in Game of Thrones series]
Local Taverns [Medieval pubs serving traditional Dalmatian food]
Maritime Museum [Museum documenting Dubrovnik's naval history]
Photography Tour [Professional photo session in most scenic locations]
tips: Game of Thrones tours available with knowledgeable guides
Download location map to identify TV series filming spots
